briefdescription.para: Windows debug session implementation using Microsoft's dbgeng COM API.

detaileddescription.para: Platform counterpart to Session_mac.cpp (macOS liblldb). Implements the Session interface declared in Session.h using IDebugClient5, IDebugControl4, IDebugSymbols3, IDebugDataSpaces4, and IDebugSystemObjects.
Threading model: single-threaded main loop. COM callbacks (Callbacks.cpp) fire on the dbgeng thread and store deferred flags on State. Main thread polls and processes those flags.
Lifecycle: initialize (Loader → COM) → (launch | attach) → pollEvents loop → shutdown.
